record.bible_text: And Joshua<WH03091> the son<WH01121> of Nun<WH05126> sent<WH07971><WTH8799> out of Shittim<WH07851> two<WH08147> men<WH0582> to spy<WH07270><WTH8764> secretly<WH02791>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Go<WH03212><WTH8798> view<WH07200><WTH8798> the land<WH0776>, even Jericho<WH03405>. And if thou utter<WH05046><WTH8686> this our business<WH01697>, then we will be quit<WH05355> of thine oath<WH07621> which thou hast made us to swear<WH07650><WTH8689>.

And she said<WH0559><WTH8799>, According unto your words<WH01697>, so <FI>be<Fi> it. And she sent them away<WH07971><WTH8762>, and they departed<WH03212><WTH8799>: and she bound<WH07194><WTH8799> the scarlet<WH08144> line<WH08615> in the window<WH02474>.<CM>
